definitions.mv_fbl_batting.sql:
-- FBL batting metrics for consumers. Governed by contract fbl.semantic.mv_fbl_batting.
-- OBP and OPS are "approx": the fictional league data has no hit-by-pitch or sacrifice-fly columns.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{catalog}}.semantic.mv_fbl_batting
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
version: 1.1
comment: "FBL batting metrics. Source grain is player-season-team. Ratios are computed from summed components, never averaged."
source: {{catalog}}.gold.fbl_fact_batting

joins:
  - name: player
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.fbl_dim_player
    'on': source.player_id = player.player_id
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: team
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.fbl_dim_team
    'on': source.team_id = team.team_id
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true

fields:
  - name: season
    expr: source.season
    display_name: "Season"
    synonyms: ["year"]
  - name: player_name
    expr: player.full_name
    display_name: "Player"
    synonyms: ["batter", "hitter"]
  - name: batting_hand
    expr: player.bats
    display_name: "Bats"
  - name: position
    expr: player.position
    display_name: "Position"
  - name: team_name
    expr: team.team_name
    display_name: "Team"
  - name: league
    expr: team.league
    display_name: "League"
  - name: city
    expr: team.city
    display_name: "City"

measures:
  - name: games
    expr: SUM(g)
    display_name: "Games"
  - name: at_bats
    expr: SUM(ab)
    display_name: "At Bats"
    synonyms: ["AB"]
  - name: hits
    expr: SUM(h)
    display_name: "Hits"
    synonyms: ["H"]
  - name: doubles
    expr: SUM(doubles)
    display_name: "Doubles"
  - name: triples
    expr: SUM(triples)
    display_name: "Triples"
  - name: home_runs
    expr: SUM(hr)
    display_name: "Home Runs"
    synonyms: ["HR", "homers"]
  - name: rbi
    expr: SUM(rbi)
    display_name: "RBI"
  - name: walks
    expr: SUM(bb)
    display_name: "Walks"
    synonyms: ["BB"]
  - name: strikeouts
    expr: SUM(so)
    display_name: "Strikeouts"
    synonyms: ["SO", "K"]
  - name: stolen_bases
    expr: SUM(sb)
    display_name: "Stolen Bases"
    synonyms: ["SB"]
  - name: batting_avg
    expr: SUM(h) / NULLIF(SUM(ab), 0)
    display_name: "Batting Average"
    synonyms: ["AVG", "BA"]
    comment: "Summed hits divided by summed at bats. Never average player averages."
  - name: on_base_pct_approx
    expr: (SUM(h) + SUM(bb)) / NULLIF(SUM(ab) + SUM(bb), 0)
    display_name: "On-Base Percentage (approx)"
    synonyms: ["OBP"]
  - name: slugging_pct
    expr: SUM(total_bases) / NULLIF(SUM(ab), 0)
    display_name: "Slugging Percentage"
    synonyms: ["SLG"]
  - name: ops_approx
    expr: MEASURE(on_base_pct_approx) + MEASURE(slugging_pct)
    display_name: "OPS (approx)"
    synonyms: ["OPS"]
  - name: home_run_rate
    expr: SUM(hr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ab), 0)
    display_name: "Home Run Rate (per at bat)"
  - name: batters
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.player_id)
    display_name: "Distinct Batters"
    comment: "Non-additive distinct count: do not sum across groups."
$$;
definitions.mv_fbl_roster.sql:
-- FBL roster metrics for consumers. Governed by contract fbl.semantic.mv_fbl_roster.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{catalog}}.semantic.mv_fbl_roster
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
version: 1.1
comment: "FBL roster metrics. Source grain is one row per player."
source: {{catalog}}.gold.fbl_dim_player

joins:
  - name: team
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.fbl_dim_team
    'on': source.team_id = team.team_id
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true

fields:
  - name: team_name
    expr: team.team_name
    display_name: "Team"
  - name: league
    expr: team.league
    display_name: "League"
  - name: position
    expr: source.position
    display_name: "Position"
  - name: batting_hand
    expr: source.bats
    display_name: "Bats"
  - name: throwing_hand
    expr: source.throws
    display_name: "Throws"

measures:
  - name: players
    expr: COUNT(1)
    display_name: "Players"
    synonyms: ["headcount", "roster size"]
  - name: avg_height_in
    expr: AVG(height_in)
    display_name: "Average Height (in)"
  - name: avg_weight_lb
    expr: AVG(weight_lb)
    display_name: "Average Weight (lb)"
  - name: switch_hitters
    expr: COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE source.bats = 'B')
    display_name: "Switch Hitters"
  - name: teams
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.team_id)
    display_name: "Distinct Teams"
$$;
definitions.10_mv_batting.sql:
-- METRIC VIEW = governed semantic object. Define each KPI ONCE here; every dashboard, notebook, Genie space
-- and BI tool then gets the same answer. Query with: SELECT dim, MEASURE(measure) FROM view GROUP BY dim.
-- Key idea: measures are aggregations evaluated at QUERY time at whatever grain the caller groups by.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{catalog}}.semantic.mv_batting
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
version: 1.1
comment: "Batting metrics. Source grain is player-season-stint. Ratios are computed from summed components, never averaged."
source: {{catalog}}.gold.fact_batting_season

joins:
  - name: player
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_player
    'on': source.player_key = player.player_key
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: team
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_team_season
    'on': source.team_season_key = team.team_season_key
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: calendar
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_season
    'on': source.season = calendar.season
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true

fields:
  - name: season
    expr: source.season
    display_name: "Season"
    synonyms: ["year"]
  - name: decade
    expr: calendar.decade
    display_name: "Decade"
  - name: baseball_era
    expr: calendar.era
    display_name: "Baseball Era"
    comment: "Business-defined era classification, see glossary term Era."
  - name: player_name
    expr: player.full_name
    display_name: "Player"
    synonyms: ["batter", "hitter", "name"]
  - name: batting_hand
    expr: player.batting_hand
    display_name: "Bats"
    synonyms: ["handedness"]
  - name: birth_country
    expr: player.birth_country
    display_name: "Birth Country"
  - name: team_name
    expr: team.team_name
    display_name: "Team"
  - name: franchise
    expr: team.franchise_name
    display_name: "Franchise"
  - name: league
    expr: team.league_id
    display_name: "League"
  - name: division
    expr: team.division_id
    display_name: "Division"

measures:
  - name: games
    expr: SUM(g)
    display_name: "Games"
  - name: at_bats
    expr: SUM(ab)
    display_name: "At Bats"
    synonyms: ["AB"]
  - name: plate_appearances
    expr: SUM(plate_appearances)
    display_name: "Plate Appearances"
    synonyms: ["PA"]
  - name: runs
    expr: SUM(r)
    display_name: "Runs"
  - name: hits
    expr: SUM(h)
    display_name: "Hits"
    synonyms: ["H"]
  - name: home_runs
    expr: SUM(hr)
    display_name: "Home Runs"
    synonyms: ["HR", "homers", "dingers"]
  - name: rbi
    expr: SUM(rbi)
    display_name: "RBI"
    synonyms: ["runs batted in"]
  - name: stolen_bases
    expr: SUM(sb)
    display_name: "Stolen Bases"
    synonyms: ["SB", "steals"]
  - name: walks
    expr: SUM(bb)
    display_name: "Walks"
    synonyms: ["BB", "bases on balls"]
  - name: strikeouts
    expr: SUM(so)
    display_name: "Strikeouts"
    synonyms: ["SO", "K"]
  - name: batting_avg
    expr: SUM(h) / NULLIF(SUM(ab), 0)
    display_name: "Batting Average"
    synonyms: ["AVG", "BA"]
    comment: "Hits divided by at bats. Never average player averages: always divide summed hits by summed at bats."
  - name: on_base_pct
    expr: (COALESCE(SUM(h), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(bb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(hbp), 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(ab), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(bb), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(hbp), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(sf), 0), 0)
    display_name: "On-Base Percentage"
    synonyms: ["OBP"]
  - name: slugging_pct
    expr: SUM(total_bases) / NULLIF(SUM(ab), 0)
    display_name: "Slugging Percentage"
    synonyms: ["SLG"]
  - name: ops
    expr: MEASURE(on_base_pct) + MEASURE(slugging_pct)
    display_name: "OPS"
    synonyms: ["on-base plus slugging"]
    comment: "Composed measure: built from two earlier measures with MEASURE(). Change OBP once, OPS follows."
  - name: isolated_power
    expr: MEASURE(slugging_pct) - MEASURE(batting_avg)
    display_name: "Isolated Power"
    synonyms: ["ISO"]
  - name: home_run_rate
    expr: SUM(hr) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(plate_appearances), 0)
    display_name: "Home Run Rate"
  - name: strikeout_rate
    expr: SUM(so) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(plate_appearances), 0)
    display_name: "Strikeout Rate"
    synonyms: ["K%"]
  - name: walk_rate
    expr: SUM(bb) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(plate_appearances), 0)
    display_name: "Walk Rate"
    synonyms: ["BB%"]
  - name: stolen_base_success_rate
    expr: SUM(sb) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sb) + SUM(cs), 0)
    display_name: "Stolen Base Success Rate"
  - name: batters
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.player_key)
    display_name: "Distinct Batters"
    comment: "Non-additive: distinct counts cannot be summed across groups. The metric view handles that for you."
  - name: home_runs_regular_stints
    expr: SUM(hr) FILTER (WHERE ab >= 400)
    display_name: "Home Runs (400+ AB stints)"
    comment: "Filtered measure example: only rows with at least 400 at bats."
  - name: cumulative_home_runs
    expr: SUM(hr)
    display_name: "Cumulative Home Runs"
    comment: "Window measure: running total ordered by season. Group by season to see the curve."
    window:
      - order: season
        range: cumulative
$$;
definitions.20_mv_pitching.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{catalog}}.semantic.mv_pitching
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
version: 1.1
comment: "Pitching metrics. Source grain is player-season-stint. innings = ipouts / 3, so every rate uses outs, not decimal innings."
source: {{catalog}}.gold.fact_pitching_season

joins:
  - name: player
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_player
    'on': source.player_key = player.player_key
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: team
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_team_season
    'on': source.team_season_key = team.team_season_key
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: calendar
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_season
    'on': source.season = calendar.season
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true

fields:
  - name: season
    expr: source.season
    display_name: "Season"
    synonyms: ["year"]
  - name: decade
    expr: calendar.decade
    display_name: "Decade"
  - name: baseball_era
    expr: calendar.era
    display_name: "Baseball Era"
  - name: player_name
    expr: player.full_name
    display_name: "Pitcher"
    synonyms: ["player", "name"]
  - name: throws
    expr: player.throws
    display_name: "Throws"
  - name: team_name
    expr: team.team_name
    display_name: "Team"
  - name: franchise
    expr: team.franchise_name
    display_name: "Franchise"
  - name: league
    expr: team.league_id
    display_name: "League"

measures:
  - name: games
    expr: SUM(g)
    display_name: "Games"
  - name: games_started
    expr: SUM(gs)
    display_name: "Games Started"
  - name: wins
    expr: SUM(w)
    display_name: "Wins"
  - name: losses
    expr: SUM(l)
    display_name: "Losses"
  - name: saves
    expr: SUM(sv)
    display_name: "Saves"
  - name: complete_games
    expr: SUM(cg)
    display_name: "Complete Games"
  - name: shutouts
    expr: SUM(sho)
    display_name: "Shutouts"
  - name: strikeouts
    expr: SUM(so)
    display_name: "Strikeouts"
    synonyms: ["K", "SO"]
  - name: walks
    expr: SUM(bb)
    display_name: "Walks"
    synonyms: ["BB"]
  - name: hits_allowed
    expr: SUM(h)
    display_name: "Hits Allowed"
  - name: home_runs_allowed
    expr: SUM(hr)
    display_name: "Home Runs Allowed"
  - name: earned_runs
    expr: SUM(er)
    display_name: "Earned Runs"
  - name: innings_pitched
    expr: SUM(ipouts) / 3.0
    display_name: "Innings Pitched"
    synonyms: ["IP"]
  - name: era
    expr: 27.0 * SUM(er) / NULLIF(SUM(ipouts), 0)
    display_name: "ERA"
    synonyms: ["earned run average"]
    comment: "Earned runs per nine innings = 27 x ER / outs recorded."
  - name: whip
    expr: 3.0 * (SUM(h) + SUM(bb)) / NULLIF(SUM(ipouts), 0)
    display_name: "WHIP"
    synonyms: ["walks plus hits per inning"]
  - name: strikeouts_per_9
    expr: 27.0 * SUM(so) / NULLIF(SUM(ipouts), 0)
    display_name: "Strikeouts per 9"
    synonyms: ["K/9"]
  - name: walks_per_9
    expr: 27.0 * SUM(bb) / NULLIF(SUM(ipouts), 0)
    display_name: "Walks per 9"
    synonyms: ["BB/9"]
  - name: home_runs_per_9
    expr: 27.0 * SUM(hr) / NULLIF(SUM(ipouts), 0)
    display_name: "Home Runs per 9"
    synonyms: ["HR/9"]
  - name: strikeout_to_walk_ratio
    expr: SUM(so) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bb), 0)
    display_name: "Strikeout-to-Walk Ratio"
    synonyms: ["K/BB"]
  - name: win_pct
    expr: SUM(w) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(w) + SUM(l), 0)
    display_name: "Win Percentage"
  - name: pitchers
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.player_key)
    display_name: "Distinct Pitchers"
$$;
definitions.30_mv_team_season.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW {{catalog}}.semantic.mv_team_season
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
version: 1.1
comment: "Team-season results, run environment, attendance and payroll. Source grain is team-season. Payroll exists from 1985 only."
source: {{catalog}}.gold.fact_team_season

joins:
  - name: team
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_team_season
    'on': source.team_season_key = team.team_season_key
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true
  - name: calendar
    source: {{catalog}}.gold.dim_season
    'on': source.season = calendar.season
    rely:
      at_most_one_match: true

fields:
  - name: season
    expr: source.season
    display_name: "Season"
    synonyms: ["year"]
  - name: decade
    expr: calendar.decade
    display_name: "Decade"
  - name: baseball_era
    expr: calendar.era
    display_name: "Baseball Era"
  - name: team_name
    expr: team.team_name
    display_name: "Team"
  - name: franchise
    expr: team.franchise_name
    display_name: "Franchise"
  - name: league
    expr: team.league_id
    display_name: "League"
  - name: division
    expr: team.division_id
    display_name: "Division"
  - name: ballpark
    expr: team.park_name
    display_name: "Ballpark"
  - name: won_world_series
    expr: team.won_world_series
    display_name: "Won World Series"
    synonyms: ["champion"]

measures:
  - name: team_seasons
    expr: COUNT(1)
    display_name: "Team Seasons"
  - name: games
    expr: SUM(g)
    display_name: "Games"
  - name: wins
    expr: SUM(w)
    display_name: "Wins"
    synonyms: ["W"]
  - name: losses
    expr: SUM(l)
    display_name: "Losses"
    synonyms: ["L"]
  - name: win_pct
    expr: SUM(w) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(w) + SUM(l), 0)
    display_name: "Win Percentage"
    synonyms: ["winning percentage", "WPCT"]
  - name: runs_scored
    expr: SUM(r)
    display_name: "Runs Scored"
  - name: runs_allowed
    expr: SUM(ra)
    display_name: "Runs Allowed"
  - name: run_differential
    expr: SUM(r) - SUM(ra)
    display_name: "Run Differential"
    synonyms: ["run diff"]
  - name: pythagorean_win_pct
    expr: POWER(SUM(r), 1.83) / NULLIF(POWER(SUM(r), 1.83) + POWER(SUM(ra), 1.83), 0)
    display_name: "Pythagorean Win Percentage"
    synonyms: ["expected win pct"]
    comment: "Expected win percentage from runs scored and allowed (exponent 1.83)."
  - name: wins_over_expected
    expr: MEASURE(win_pct) - MEASURE(pythagorean_win_pct)
    display_name: "Win Pct Over Expected"
    synonyms: ["luck"]
  - name: attendance
    expr: SUM(attendance)
    display_name: "Attendance"
  - name: avg_attendance_per_home_game
    expr: SUM(attendance) / NULLIF(SUM(g_home) FILTER (WHERE attendance IS NOT NULL), 0)
    display_name: "Average Attendance per Home Game"
    comment: "Only counts home games where attendance was recorded, so missing data does not drag the average down."
  - name: payroll
    expr: SUM(payroll_usd)
    display_name: "Payroll (USD)"
    comment: "Sum of player salaries. NULL before 1985."
  - name: cost_per_win
    expr: SUM(payroll_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(w) FILTER (WHERE payroll_usd IS NOT NULL), 0)
    display_name: "Payroll per Win (USD)"
    comment: "Wins in the denominator are restricted to seasons that have payroll, otherwise pre-1985 wins would flatter the ratio."
$$;
